# Opens the data4health user interface

## Description

The 'd4h_ui()' function opens the data4health user interface in a web browser. It provides an interactive environment for users to explore and manipulate health-related datasets. The interface allows for data cleaning, filtering, aggregation, and visualization, making it easier to work with epidemiological line list data.

```r
d4h_ui()
```

## Returns

Called for its side effects. Opens the Shiny app in the browser.

## Examples

```r
if(interactive()){
   # open the data4health user interface
   d4h_ui()
}
```
